scope: User-authorized local development training pilot; not an M2 mechanism result or final benchmark.

flow.mask: same valid backward-warp mask applied to both raw and aligned residuals

training.checkpoint_selection: minimum calibration clean BCE; tie earliest
training.augmentation: Uniform batch-level condition selection; horizontal flip p=0.5 coherent within each clip batch

limitations: Single real source and two legacy fake generators; not cross-generator generalization.
Historical audit data already used for metadata diagnostics; no confirmatory test claims.
Nominal-CFR index plan with recorded decoded timestamps; comprehensive source timing still not certified.
Resizing/cropping removes metadata fields but cannot guarantee removal of resampling or codec fingerprints.
Corruptions are applied after spatial preprocessing; they do not simulate full platform transmission.
Small random-initialized CNN/GRU baselines; not reproductions of MAST or other published detectors.
The two temporal baselines share parameters and a common validity mask; frame_mean is a different architecture.
JPEG70 and gaussian5 are seen training conditions in v2; results on them are not unseen-corruption generalization.
amendment: Fixed after inspecting v1 training/calibration curves and before either audit evaluation: lr reduced, weight decay increased, uniform clean/JPEG70/gaussian5 batch sampling plus coherent horizontal flip. No model architecture changes. This is a training-recipe adjustment, not an isolated innovation ablation.
